$schema-note: StayEdge Brand Tokens v1.0 — machine-readable single source of truth, extracted from Brand-Book.pdf (Brand Operating System v1.0, July 2026). Values marked 'derived' were measured from the book's own page design rather than stated verbatim.

meta.descriptor: Airbnb growth consultancy for hosts across South India

primaryPurple.role: The anchor. Logo, headers, key CTAs and brand moments. Never below 40% of a layout.

softLavender.role: The accent. Highlights, eyebrows, diamond detail and subtitles. Warmth against the purple.

richCharcoal.role: The ground. Dark pages, dividers and premium surfaces. A near-black tinted purple, never pure black.

offWhite.role: The breath. Light-page canvas and reversed type. Softer than pure white, easier on the eye.

deepPurple.role: derived: deep purple panels, cover shapes

darkPlum.role: derived: card surfaces on dark pages

paleLavender.role: derived: light cards, shortest bar on purple field

greyLavender.role: derived: muted body text on dark, tagline, labels

color.psychology: Purple signals premium judgement and ambition — the colour of people who charge what they're worth. Charcoal grounds it in seriousness; lavender keeps it human.
rules: Primary Purple never below 40% of a layout
Never introduce off-palette or neon accents
Only palette HEX values used (pre-publish checklist item)

pairingRules: Boldonse for impact only — never body
Italiana & Lora italic carry the human register
One display + one body per layout, no more
Jura always tracked wide, always uppercase
IBM Plex Serif reserved for numbers & specs
typography.googleFonts: https://fonts.google.com/ — Boldonse, Italiana, Outfit, Lora, Jura, IBM Plex Serif (all available on Google Fonts)

logo.name: The Rising Edge
logo.clearSpace: >= height of one bar on all sides

layout-derived.pageHeader: Eyebrow left (Jura, tracked, uppercase) + breadcrumb right 'StayEdge / NN / Topic', hairline rule below
layout-derived.pageFooter: '© 2026 STAYEDGE' left · page number centre (purple) · 'CONFIDENTIAL' right (Jura, tracked)
layout-derived.sectionDivider: Rich Charcoal full page, oversized ghost section number top-right, Jura eyebrow, Boldonse title in off-white, Italiana subtitle in lavender, purple edge-strip on left
layout-derived.principle: Generous margins, clear hierarchy; nothing overflows its container

voice.positioning: We are the sharp operator, not the loud guru.

pillars.name: Clear, not clever
pillars.rule: Say the useful thing plainly. Jargon is a tax on the reader.

pillars.name: Confident, not loud
pillars.rule: We state results and let them stand. No hype, no exclamation marks.

pillars.name: Warm, not casual
pillars.rule: Human and encouraging — but we respect the host's time and money.

pillars.name: Specific, not vague
pillars.rule: Numbers, timeframes and next steps. Vague advice helps no one.

cta.style-derived: Pill buttons; primary = Primary Purple fill with off-white text; secondary = Deep Purple/Pale Lavender fill
